title: SE Review Schema
description: Review protocol schema for the SE cascade (Issue #339 B5). One protocol per review iteration, file convention: REVIEW_<YYYY-MM-DD>_<scope>.md under the reviews directory. Findings are referenced by ID from REQ files, never inlined.

review_id.description: Review ID RVW-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN (NNN = three digits, monotonically increasing per day).

target_req.description: Reviewed requirement ID (e.g., REQ-L1-007) or scope reference.

iteration.description: Review iteration number (1-based). A re-review is iteration N+1.

status.description: Lifecycle status: open (findings open) -> response (generator responded) -> closed (findings resolved).

reviewer.description: Agent that performed the review (e.g., se-critic).

findings.description: Findings of this iteration. Referenced by ID from REQ files via review_id — never copied inline.

id.description: Finding ID: RVW-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN-<k> (k = two digits within the protocol).

description.description: What was found. Lives here, not in the REQ file.

suggested_fix.description: Concrete fix proposal for the generator.
